affected_parameters: Published example: 1023/1024-bit factors, 2046-bit n, q=4n-1 with 2048-bit q
attack_result: One-query universal fresh-message forgery accepted by the ordinary full-parameter pairing verifier
attack_runtime_scope: Independent fresh-key same-s point transport only; pairing verification and the complete execution are recorded separately.
attack_technique: Exploit the public scalar kappa_m in H(m)=[kappa_m]G_H to scale one queried signature point by (kappa_target/kappa_source)*g^(h_target-h_source), while reusing the queried scalar response exactly.
attack_title: On a Roll: A One-Query Universal Forgery against Poulakis--Rolland v2
conditions: Exact ePrint 2012/134 revision 20150430:055329; choose a source message with public gcd(kappa_source,n)=1 and a target for which the scheme's affine signature encoding is defined.
family: Composite-order pairing signature combining factoring and elliptic-curve discrete logarithms
hash_instantiation: SHAKE256 with explicit local domain separation; the paper leaves h, the KDF, and byte framing abstract.
independent_reproduction_scope: A separate standard-library implementation generated a new exact-order subgroup generator, secret exponent, public key, and signing split at the published endpoint; it accepted fixed-target same-s and range-sampled forgeries and rejected six negative controls.
related_prior_techniques: Tibouchi's 2011 thesis, Section 3.2, pages 38--40: one-signature scaling against BLS with a public-scalar hash-to-group map
Boneh--Lynn--Shacham short signatures and their bilinear verification equation
verification_basis: Full-parameter primary execution and replay, passed adversarial checks, and an independent fresh-key full-parameter reproduction
